name: Hostile UAS threat — detect, classify, react
description: A watch position is approached over sixty seconds per wave by a mixed sky: hostile FPV UAS, cruise missiles and jets, with consumer quadcopters, airliners and birds among them. The operator has every sensor feed on, a classifier's opinion beside each contact, and the shot. Scoring rewards calibration — catching the classifier when it is wrong — not kills.
notes: Type keys are Sentraspere contact types. `drone` and `quad` are bound to catalogued commercial UAS; the others are synthetic training abstractions.
